T: Late shift. Black coffee. Long night.
D: A lonely Vietnam vet driving a night cab grows unhinged on New York's streets.
P: Pour the coffee when Travis sits with the other cabbies at the all-night diner.
S: the cabbies' hangout at the end of every shift
Cut russets into thick chips, rinse, blanch at 140C for 6 minutes, rest 20 minutes, fry at 185C until crisp. Salt and a shaker of white vinegar on the table.
for a man who barely eats, laid out like a cab driver's dinner
Saltine crackers with slabs of sharp cheddar at room temperature, half-sour pickles cut in spears and a smear of hot English mustard.
M: Rare roast beef warmed in gravy and piled on toast, with mash and buttered peas, New York diner style.
Iris's diner breakfast with jam toast
the coffee shop breakfast where Travis tries to talk Iris into going home

Fried eggs, crisp bacon and golden hash browns with buttered toast spread with strawberry jam and a sprinkle of sugar, Iris style. Grate 600g washed potatoes, squeeze very dry in a tea towel and season. Fry in 3 tbsp oil as 4 flat cakes over medium heat for 6 minutes a side until crisp. Meanwhile fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp and keep warm. Fry 8 eggs in butter. Toast 8 slices white bread, butter, spread with strawberry jam and sprinkle with caster sugar. Plate everything together.
W: his breakfast of white bread and peach brandy, made properly
Butter thick white bread, layer with sliced peaches soaked in brandy and brown sugar. Pour over 4 eggs whisked with 500ml milk and vanilla, rest 20 minutes, bake at 170C for 40 minutes.
K: the night shift, and the peach brandy Travis pours over everything

Strong drip coffee with a nip of peach brandy and brown sugar, topped with a spoon of lightly whipped cream. Brew 800ml strong drip coffee using 50g ground coffee. Lightly whip 100ml thickened cream until just thick. Into each of 4 diner mugs put 1 tsp brown sugar and 30ml peach brandy, then pour in 200ml hot coffee and stir. Spoon a little cream on top and serve straight away.

s.note: the cabbies' hangout at the end of every shift
s.how: Cut 1kg russets into thick chips, rinse and dry well. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes, rest 20 minutes, then fry again at 185C until crisp and golden. Salt hard and put a shaker of white vinegar on the table.

s.note: for a man who barely eats, laid out like a cab driver's dinner
s.how: Take 250g sharp cheddar out of the fridge an hour ahead and cut into thick slabs. Cut 4 dill pickles into spears. Lay out with a sleeve of saltine crackers and a small dish of hot English mustard for smearing.

m.how: Warm 500g sliced rare roast beef in 400ml hot beef gravy for 2 minutes. Toast 4 thick slices of white bread, lay on plates, pile on the beef and pour over more gravy. Serve with mash made from 800g potatoes and 40g butter, and buttered peas.

w.note: his breakfast of white bread and peach brandy, made properly
w.how: Soak 2 drained tins of sliced peaches in 3 tbsp brandy and 2 tbsp brown sugar. Butter 8 slices of thick white bread and layer with the peaches. Pour over 4 eggs whisked with 500ml milk and vanilla, rest 20 minutes and bake at 170C for 40 minutes.

d.note: the night shift, and the peach brandy Travis pours over everything
d.how: Brew 800ml strong drip coffee using 50g ground coffee. Lightly whip 100ml thickened cream until just thick. Into each of 4 diner mugs put 1 tsp brown sugar and 30ml peach brandy, then pour in 200ml hot coffee and stir. Spoon a little cream on top and serve straight away.
